description: PIL policy: entry pages and unversioned files always revalidate
expression: (http.host eq "pkuidv.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/tactical-friend/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/zhanshuyanlian/")) and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/tactical-friend/_assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/tactical-friend/3d/releases/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/zhanshuyanlian/_assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/zhanshuyanlian/3d/releases/")))

description: PIL policy: content snapshots and 3D releases are immutable
expression: (http.host eq "pkuidv.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/tactical-friend/_assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/tactical-friend/3d/releases/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/zhanshuyanlian/_assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/zhanshuyanlian/3d/releases/")))
